comparison.objective: Place four unequal weights on a pivoted plank in matched simultaneous pairs without tipping it; distinct from damper commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual synchronized placement and moment balancing versus counterholding, key engagement, fine collar rotation, and iterative cycling.
comparison.success_condition: All weights placed one red and one yellow per side; tilt over 6 degrees or leaving ridge latches zero. Candidate checks impact absorption and lock drift instead.
comparison.reason: Both use physical response, but static moment balancing and synchronized placement test a different ability from damping calibration.
